column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for each surface and physical reading. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the environmental reading. FK to EnvironmentalReadingsCore.monitor_code.
REAL. Vibration measurements in millimeters squared. Example: 0.461.
BIGINT. Noise level measurement in decibels. Example: 47.
REAL. Dust level in milligrams per square meter. Example: 1.74.
BIGINT. Microbial colony-forming units (CFU) detected. Example: 234.0.
REAL. Mold index indicating the level of mold presence. Example: 0.1.
TEXT. Recorded pest activity level. **NULL means no pest activity reported.**. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
BIGINT. Number of pest traps set. Example: 10.
TEXT. Species of pests detected. **NULL means no species identified.**. Possible values: Beetles, Booklice, Moths, Silverfish.
REAL. pH level of the surface. Example: 6.7.
REAL. Moisture percentage on the surface. Example: 10.3.
TEXT. Risk level due to salt exposure. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
REAL. Metal corrosion rate on the surface. Example: 0.04.
REAL. Organic degradation rate. Example: 0.47.
REAL. Color difference in surface due to environmental factors. Example: 1.99.
REAL. Temperature of the surface. Example: 19.11.
REAL. Relative humidity on the surface. Example: 45.46.
TEXT. Risk of damage due to environmental conditions. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
TEXT. Thermal image data of the surface. **NULL means no thermal image provided.**. Possible values: Attention Required, Critical, Normal.
TEXT. Structural stability condition. **NULL means no stability data provided.**. Possible values: Major Issues, Minor Issues, Stable.
TEXT. Notes about any cracks detected on the surface. Possible values: Minor Changes, No Changes, Significant Changes.
REAL. Deformation in millimeters. Example: 0.08.
REAL. Weight percentage of certain materials on the surface. Example: -0.001.
BIGINT. Amount of dust detected on the surface. Example: 5.7.
REAL. Oxygen percentage in the surface environment. Example: 20.8.
REAL. Nitrogen percentage in the surface environment. Example: 78.75.
